faqs.answer: Motion graphics are animated visuals, text, icons, shapes, or graphics that move, used to explain something, highlight a point, or just make a piece of content more interesting to watch.
faqs.question: What are motion graphics exactly?

faqs.answer: A regular video is filmed footage, while motion graphics are built digitally using tools like Adobe After Effects to animate elements rather than filming anything at all.
faqs.question: How is motion graphics animation different from a regular video?

faqs.answer: Yes, this is actually pretty common. We often add animated captions, transitions, or callouts into footage that is already edited, just to strengthen a specific part of the video.
faqs.question: Can motion graphics be added into videos I already have?

faqs.answer: It ranges from fairly simple text or icon animation to more detailed explainer style graphics and logo animation, and we choose based on what actually suits your content.
faqs.question: What kinds of motion graphics do you work with?

faqs.answer: Yes. Since movement naturally catches attention faster than a still image, it tends to help ads stop the scroll a bit more effectively.
faqs.question: Do motion graphics help with social media ads?

faqs.answer: Yes, that is one of the more common requests we get, breaking down how a product works into something simple and visual instead of a long written explanation.
faqs.question: Can you build an animated explainer for my product?

faqs.answer: Yes, that is the whole point. We build the animation style around your brand colours, fonts, and general tone so it feels like it belongs, not like something bolted on separately.
faqs.question: Will the animation actually match my existing brand?

faqs.answer: Mostly, yes. It gives us the flexibility to build something custom instead of relying on generic, pre-made templates.
faqs.question: Do you use Adobe After Effects for this kind of work?

faqs.answer: It depends on how detailed the animation is. Simple text animation is quick, a full explainer takes longer, but we work around your content timeline either way.
faqs.question: How long does this kind of work usually take?
